title: Keep the two run meanings clear
when: When a QA execution starts or the user first inspects Activity alongside a deployment run.
need: A deployment run ships a candidate. A QA plan execution coordinates cases; individual QA runs are attempts on their requirements, producing artifacts and verdicts. A screenshot or completed capture may still await review. A lost response leaves an unknown outcome. Keep the exact execution and live custody, reconcile its saved request/cursor, and re-enter by execution id without resetting or replaying a one-shot action.
surface: QA Activity/case page; plan execution output; reference records
gap: Review question: should JOURNEYS give the first QA activity view this short vocabulary instead of calling every layer a run?
review: Observed source recovery contract; focused regression evidence is required before release. Live campaign behavior remains unverified.
surface_notes: QA execution / attempt output → evidence and verdict: Continuation state names what happens next. The saved attempt/artifacts/verdict establish only the declared subject, target and candidate; a capture may still await review.

Plan communication pause → exact execution re-entry: compact check-ins retry only the same request; permission, custody loss and unadvanced action outcomes stay blocked. Terminal history remains terminal.
After failed QA, classify and act: product defect -> return to implementation; setup failure -> record the blocker; unclear cause -> investigate now.
